tool.description: Validate, sort, and pretty-print BibTeX bibliography entries. Pass the raw .bib source in 'bibtex'; the tool parses @article/@book/etc. entries plus @string/@preamble/@comment, reports any syntax error, then re-emits them cleanly with one field per indented line.

bibtex.description: The BibTeX bibliography source to validate and pretty-print.

sort.description: Reorder entries: 'none' (default) keeps source order; 'key' sorts case-insensitively by cite key; 'type-key' sorts by entry type then key. @string/@preamble/@comment items stay at the front.

sort_fields.description: When true, sort the fields within each entry alphabetically by name. Default false (keep source order).

indent.description: Spaces to indent each field line, 0-16. Default 2.

align_values.description: When true, pad field names so all '=' signs in an entry line up. Default false (a single space before '=').

lowercase_type.description: When true (default), lowercase the entry type and the @string/@preamble/@comment keyword. Field names are always lowercased.

check_duplicates.description: When true (default), error if two entries share a cite key (case-insensitive) — BibTeX silently keeps only the first, so a duplicate key is a real bug. Set false to format anyway.
